threads.name: The unrecognized treasure map
threads.note: Uriah plans to copy the map, Father William added the witch's home and the Barrow Mound to it, and the party plans to check a marked spot on the way. The treasure is still unfound and the original marks are still unidentified.

threads.name: The Clurichen of the riverbanks
threads.note: The Clurichen, Naggeneen, was caught and is now held in a bag behind Quinn's bar (beat_26, beat_29, beat_40), so the nightly roaming danger has changed in nature. He is captive rather than destroyed, and his offers of a pot of gold, a secret and good luck remain open.

threads.name: The dragon near Brandonsford
threads.note: George revealed the lair's location and that the dragon will soon fly (beat_69). The party learned its poison, sulfur breath and impenetrable scales, that it can only be killed with Brandon's sword (beat_61), and that Eric may not have the bounty (beat_71).

threads.name: Hiring Lady Hilda
threads.note: Not touched this Session; Lady Hilda was only seen at the tavern.

threads.name: Bentley's missing shipment
threads.note: Shipments still have not arrived, and the cause remains unknown.

threads.name: Sir Phidipaldi's challenge to Eric the Reeve
threads.note: Not touched this Session; the challenge stands unaccepted.

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer of hire
threads.note: Not touched this Session; Ned was only seen at the tavern.

threads.name: Shamus the mule
threads.note: Dunk offered 20 gold for the mule. Gill will only lower his price once his sons return, so the purchase is still pending.

threads.name: Warwick the smith and his mithril shirt
threads.note: Dunk confirmed the mithril shirt is magical and now aims to get it (beat_47). Ingrid's secret nightly visits (beat_33) partly answer what Warwick is warding against. Why he won't sell the shirt is still unknown.

threads.name: Quinn's vanishing ale
threads.note: The ale thief was revealed to be Naggeneen (beat_27). Sir Phidipaldi's help was delivered and Quinn paid the party (beat_29), so nothing is owed or unknown.

threads.name: Squints and Trout's Halfling Corps
threads.note: Trout recruited Squints under set terms, including second pick of treasure after the elite members (beat_43), and gave him Brother Dirk as a follower (beat_93). Those terms and the party's secret plan not to rescue him keep the arrangement open.

threads.name: Dunk's sleeping-potion deal with Ingrid
threads.note: This is Dunk's stated plan to get Warwick's armor (beat_47). He agreed to help Ingrid dose Warwick and has delivered diluted faun wine (beat_81). The potion, the night meeting and Ingrid's feeling that she owes him are still pending.

threads.name: Sir Brandon's sword in the Barrow Mound
threads.note: Father William says the dragon cannot be killed without the sword buried with Brandon (beat_61), so retrieving it serves the dragon hunt. The party is now heading to the Barrow, and Brother Dirk is with them.

threads.name: Uriah's penance pledge to Father William
threads.note: Uriah promised Father William penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation for its upkeep. This promise to a separate counterpart has not yet been fulfilled.

threads.name: Fairies coming out of hiding
threads.note: Ingrid reports that fairies which used to stay hidden are encroaching more often. This is a question or danger that stands apart from the existing threads.

threads.name: The man-eating giant in the north woods
threads.note: The party took Brother Dirk from the giant who meant to eat him and outran it. Escaping does not end the danger of a giant living on the route north.

standalone_beats.reason: Dunk's apparent immunity to faun wine astonished the fauns and is a notable trait.
Father William offers to heal Uriah if he is injured.
Uriah bought essence of wolfsbane and healing mandrake root tea from Ingrid.
